meaning:
συν-κλείω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for סגר ;]
to shut together, enclose, shut in on all sides: of a catch of fish, Luk.5:6; metaphorically (Psa.31:9, al.), Rom.11:32, Gal.3:22-23.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.
For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
